statement: NVIDIA began production shipments of Vera Rubin and expects it to be the fastest product ramp in company history.
why: A fast ramp of the next platform is how constrained supply gets relieved, if the chain can keep up.

impact.mechanism: Production shipments of the next-generation platform add deliverable units and pull forward upstream orders.

evidence.source: MarketBeat (Q2 FY2027 earnings call transcript excerpt)
evidence.excerpt: We commenced production shipments of Vera Rubin earlier this month...we expect Vera Rubin to mark the fastest product ramp in NVIDIA's history.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript excerpt of forward-looking management commentary.
